appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light or dark mode, or follow the system preference.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language, or follow the system setting.
language.label: Language

version.title: Application version
version.checkHint: Opens the built-in updater to download and install a newer release when one is available.
version.raspberryPiHint: On this Raspberry Pi install, update from the shell with <0>sudo ./scripts/goldbuslight-pi.sh update --latest</0>. Do not use the in-app updater here — it can remove the binary and leave only a <1>GoldbusLight.bak</1> file behind.

window.title: Window display
window.description: Expand the application window for stage use or kiosk-style displays.

companion.title: Phone companion
companion.listening: Companion is listening. Join this host’s Wi‑Fi or LAN and open a URL below on your phone.
companion.starting: Waiting for the companion server to start…
companion.qrHint: Scan to open the companion app.

backup.title: Configuration backup
backup.description: Export or import all persisted data: controller settings, WLED devices, DMX fixtures and party config, general tab state, and per-fixture live layouts. Use this to copy a complete setup from one host to another.

wledTab.disabledHint: WLED routes, menu entries, and device actions are disabled while this is off.
wledTab.apDisabledWhileOff: Access point is forced off while WLED component is disabled.
wledTab.apConfirmEnableDescription: This will save your settings and bring up the Wi‑Fi access point on this host.
wledTab.apConfirmDisableDescription: This will save your settings and tear down the Wi‑Fi access point on this host.
wledTab.apConfirmApplyFieldsDescription: The access point is already running. Save and apply the updated connection settings to the live network?
wledTab.ipNeighborsModalDescription: Run an nmap host discovery on this Linux host to list devices on the local network, including clients of the access point. Look for 10.42.0.x addresses when using the built-in hotspot.
wledTab.ipNeighborsResultEmpty: No result yet. Click Scan network to discover hosts.
wledTab.ipNeighborsNoHosts: No hosts found in the scan output.
wledTab.ipNeighborsCopyHint: Click a row to copy its IP

dmxTab.usbProtocolHint: Detected framing is shown next to each device (Enttec Pro, Open DMX, or auto-probe). Enttec Pro / Eurolite PRO / DMXking use Pro packets; Open DMX / Cable adapters use BREAK + raw DMX.

sweep.title: DMX fixture channel sweep
sweep.description: Sweeps each configured channel of one fixture from 0→255 while all other channels on that fixture stay at zero. The universe is blacked out first so you can see which physical function responds. Output uses the same USB / Art-Net configuration as the DMX settings above.
sweep.partyRunningAlert: Party mode is on — stop it before starting a sweep.
sweep.sweepSpeedHint: Higher is faster (shorter delay between DMX steps).
sweep.currentStepDetail: Fixture channel offset: <0>{{offset}}</0> ({{type}}) · DMX address: <1>{{address}}</1> · Value: <2>{{value}}</2>
sweep.running: Running — Space to pause and log this position

errors.selectFixture: Select a fixture with at least one DMX channel.
errors.partyRunning: Stop party mode before running the channel sweep test.
